committee: * Presentation: Certificate No. 390-38 (COR) -Senator Shelly V. Calvo
title: The presentation of Certificate No. 390-38 (COR) “Relative to recognizing the art exhibition entitled “Hiwaga at Alamat: Into the World of Philippine Folklore and Mythology,” to be held on Saturday, May 23, 2026, at 2:30 PM at Micronesia Mall. Held in celebration of Philippine Heritage Month and the 80th Anniversary of Philippine-U.S. relations, the exhibition showcases the artworks and creative expressions of Filipino-American artists on Guam, highlighting the richness of Philippine folklore, mythology, culture, and artistic heritage. The presentation will recognize the participating artists…
